_note: GHL's public API does not support creating pipelines, workflows, or a generic 'publish campaign' call (confirmed in docs/12-live-ghl-connection.md). Every blueprint below with implementation:'ghl_manual_or_snapshot' must be built once by hand in the GHL UI or shipped inside a snapshot — this codebase cannot create it via API. Blueprints with implementation:'python_code' are real, tested code in this repo. 'hybrid' means part GHL config, part code (a GHL workflow calls a webhook this repo handles).

workflows.name: Daily content-idea generation
actions: Pull content pillar rotation + content mix targets
Propose N campaign ideas respecting content_mix.json ratios
Create CampaignBrief drafts in IDEA state

workflows.name: Weekly content-calendar generation
actions: CMO reviews the week's IDEA-state briefs
Approves which ideas advance to BRIEF_CREATED

workflows.name: Brand review
actions: Advance to COMPLIANCE_REVIEW or back to REVISION_REQUIRED

workflows.name: Human-approval notification
actions: GHL side (manual config): notify executive approver via SMS/email/internal notification workflow

workflows.name: Video-generation submission
actions: Submit VideoGenerationJob via AvatarVideoAdapter (dry-run/mock unless live-authorized)

workflows.name: Video completion (webhook or polling)
actions: Advance to VIDEO_REVIEW on success, FAILED + retry logic on failure

workflows.name: Video review
actions: Human/agent reviews final asset against script + disclosures

workflows.name: Social scheduling
actions: Hand off to GHL Social Planner (or documented SocialPlatformAdapter) — dry-run unless live-authorized

workflows.name: Publishing confirmation
actions: Record platform post ID/URL/timestamp or error

workflows.name: Failed-job recovery
actions: Exponential-backoff retry up to configured max attempts

workflows.name: Comment and DM keyword lead capture
actions: GHL side (manual config): native keyword-comment/DM automation where supported
This repo: normalize + sanitize inbound text as UNTRUSTED DATA ONLY, never executed

workflows.name: Appointment attribution
actions: Link appointment to originating campaign/CTA via LeadAttribution

workflows.name: Monthly content optimization
actions: Rank hooks/formats/CTAs/platforms/times by actual conversion evidence
Produce OptimizationRecommendation records for approval — never auto-applied

workflows.name: Emergency pause and global kill switch
actions: GlobalControls.pause_publishing(reason) blocks every publish-directing agent immediately
Distinct from the full-system pause used by the Revenue OS
